summary: Comprehensive Playwright UI testing of BhojPe KDS (frontend only, mock data). Verified setup/pairing flow, KDS board columns/counts, full order lifecycle (NEW->COOKING->READY->COMPLETED->DONE removal), age timer live increment, filters, search, demo controls (Generate New KOT + fullscreen alert, toggle server -> offline banner), Items OOS confirm+sync, Colors change/reset, Token screen preview, /token standalone page, sound toggle, persistence via localStorage reload, and responsive layout (390px, 320px no overflow). 14/16 explicit assertions passed; 2 apparent failures are test-artifact false positives caused by responsive dual-render (see notes). No JS/console errors captured other than benign a11y warnings.

integration_issues.flow: Demo Controls > Generate New KOT from within Settings drawer
integration_issues.issue: NewOrderAlert renders under the Sheet (settings drawer) overlay, so its dismiss-alert-btn is intercepted by the drawer overlay. Alert still auto-dismisses after 5s, but user cannot manually dismiss until closing the drawer. Consider elevating NewOrderAlert z-index above the sheet overlay (z-50 -> z-[60]) or auto-closing settings when a new KOT alert fires.

issues: Radix Dialog/Sheet console warning: 'Missing Description or aria-describedby for DialogContent' — add DialogDescription or aria-describedby to Settings drawer and OOS confirm dialog for a11y.

action_items: OPTIONAL: Raise z-index of NewOrderAlert above Radix Sheet overlay (or auto-close SettingsDrawer when an alert fires) so the fullscreen alert is fully interactable when the demo control that triggers it lives inside the drawer.
OPTIONAL: Add aria-describedby / DialogDescription to Settings Sheet and OOS confirmation dialog to silence Radix a11y warnings.

OPTIONAL: The responsive layout renders BOTH the desktop md:grid and the md:hidden mobile column simultaneously (hidden via Tailwind classes), which duplicates data-testid values (kot-card-*, column-*) in the DOM. Not a user-facing bug, but breaks strict test scoping. Consider conditional rendering via a resize hook or use unique testids per breakpoint.
critical_code_review_comments: kdsState.js reducer 'reset' preserves paired+station but re-seeds everything else via initialState() — good pattern.
localStorage write on every state change is fine for MVP but for many-orders scale, debounce it.
KDS.jsx renders both md:grid and md:hidden variants unconditionally — duplicate data-testids. Acceptable for now but noted above.
Setup.jsx: unlockAudio() called on all pairing/entry actions — good.
No hardcoded URLs; app is pure frontend/mock as required.

success_rate.frontend: ~95% (14/16 assertions PASS; 2 failures are duplicate-DOM test artifacts, not real bugs)

context_for_next_testing_agent: Frontend-only mock app. Verified: /setup redirect on empty localStorage, prefilled BHP-8F42-K91 / POS-7F42A9, pairing state transitions, KDS 4-column layout with counts (new=4 cooking=4 ready=2 completed=5 initial), full order lifecycle via kot-action-btn / kot-done-btn, live timer, filters (filter-new/dine-in/all), search + clear, demo-generate-kot -> new-order-alert visual, colors change+reset, items OOS confirm dialog (cancel keeps Available, confirm shows OUT OF STOCK), token-screen-preview, /token page renders, sound-toggle-btn switches state, demo-toggle-server shows offline-banner with WifiOff icon and 'LOCAL MODE', persistence across reload, mobile 390px+320px no horizontal overflow. Known duplicate testids in DOM due to responsive dual-render — when writing selectors, scope to '.md\\:grid ...' for desktop or '.md\\:hidden ...' for mobile. The one integration nit: dismissing new-order-alert while settings drawer is open is blocked by the sheet overlay (alert still auto-dismisses).
rca of the issue: The two Playwright assertion failures ('filter-new shows only new column cards 6/3', 'Search KOT 1025') are false-positives caused by KDS.jsx rendering both the desktop `hidden md:grid` container and the mobile `md:hidden` container simultaneously — Tailwind hides one via display:none but both remain in the DOM with the same data-testid values (column-new, kot-card-1025). A page-wide querySelectorAll therefore counts each card twice. Functional behavior verified correct via scoped inspection; no code fix required unless duplicate testids are undesirable for tooling.
